ai.dialogDescription: Describe the template structure - paste a list or dictate. AI will propose sections and items aligned with your company.
ai.outlinePlaceholder:
E.g.:
1. Consultation
- Initial meeting
- Needs analysis
2. Delivery
- ...
ai.outlineHint: At least 20 characters. Paste a numbered list or use the microphone button.
ai.modeEnhanceHint: Keep your outline and add missing sections typical for your industry.
ai.modeFaithfulHint: Stay close to the provided text with minimal changes.

ai.promptMissing: Template outline not found. Go back and try again.
